channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Galway produce superb comeback to snatch a point from Tralee
item.description: Shane McGrath's late two-pointer saw Galway complete an 11-point turnaround against Kerry in Tralee this evening to earn a draw in this thrilling Allianz Football League Division 1 encounter.

item.title: O'Callaghan two-pointers key as Dubs earn first league win at Monaghan's expense
item.description: Con O'Callaghan came up huge down the home stretch as Dublin claimed their first win of the 2026 Allianz Football League by handing Monaghan their third defeat of the campaign.

item.title: "I was surprised he actually threw it in"
item.description: Meath manager Robbie Brennan says he was surprised to see the ball thrown in as a row broke out between the Royals and Louth in one section of it pitch at Croke Park yesterday.

item.title: Ladies: Late Leahy goal sees Cork seal victory over Armagh in Crossmaglen
item.description: Cork made the long trip to Crossmaglen on Sunday for this rescheduled Lidl National Football League Division 1 fixture after the match was postponed last weekend due to a waterlogged pitch in Dromintee and they made the journey worthwhile as they edged out Armagh in tough conditions.

item.title: Carlow, Leitrim and Longford claim more victories in Division 4
item.description: Carlow made it three wins from three in Division 4 of the Allianz Football League by edging out Tipperary on a 1-17 to 1-14 scoreline in Thurles this afternoon.

item.title: Limerick hand Wexford first Division 3 defeat as Clare record vital win against Fermanagh
item.description: Limerick edged Wexford by 1-15 to 1-14 in Rathkeale this afternoon to claim their first win in this year's Allianz Football League Division 3 campaign.

item.title: Tyrone claim first Division 2 victory while Cork make it three wins out of three
item.description: Tyrone got their first win of the Allianz Football League Division 2 campaign by inflicting Cavan's third successive loss (2-23 to 1-14) in Omagh this afternoon.

item.title: O'Donnell goal helps Donegal see off Mayo for third successive win in Division 1
item.description: Donegal moved two points clear at the top of the Allianz Football League Division 1 table thanks to a convincing 1-19 to 0-14 victory over Mayo in Letterkenny this afternoon.

item.title: Rossies defeat Orchard men for back-to-back wins in Division 1
item.description: Roscommon's goals proved vital as they picked up their second win in Division 1 of the Allianz Football League at Armagh's expense this afternoon.
